description: This file contains utility methods for working with grain interface types in Orleans, including retrieving methods for grain interfaces/classes, computing a class type code, and comparing MethodInfo objects.

classes.name: GrainInterfaceUtils
classes.description: Provides static utility methods for analyzing and handling grain interface and class types in Orleans.

classes.name: MethodInfoComparer
classes.description: A singleton class implementing equality and comparison logic for MethodInfo objects, used internally within GrainInterfaceUtils.

methods.name: GetMethods
methods.description: Retrieves all relevant methods from a given grain type, optionally including inherited methods or only declared methods.

methods.name: GetGrainClassTypeCode
methods.description: Computes a unique integer type code for a grain class based on its runtime type name.
